page_data.en:
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.    File No...........
C.S.6, Special Branch...........8609
REPORT
Date.........July. 9, 19 38.
Subject (in full)................GALKIN, M. - Arrival in Shanghai.
Made by...D.S.I. Medvedeff...........Forwarded by... Inspector
Michael GALKIN, aged 34, Russian merchant,
arrived in Shanghai on June 29 from Dairen by the s.s. "Hoten
Maru". He put up at the Burlington Hotel where he resided
until July 7, when he left for an undisclosed address, probably
in the French Concession. Before leaving the hotel, he
intimated that he will return to the hotel after about ten
days. It is believed that M. Galkin is connected with the
"Harbinskoye Vremia", a pro-Japanese newspaper, published in
Harbin.
Further enquiries proceeding.
N. Medvedeff
D. S. I.
D.C. (Special Branch).
page_data.zh:
上海公共租界工部局警务处。 档案编号...........
C.S.6，特别处...........8609
报告
日期.........1938年7月9日。
事由（全称）................加尔金，M. - 抵沪。
呈报人...特别调查员梅德韦杰夫...........转呈人... 督察
迈克尔·加尔金（Michael GALKIN），34岁，俄国商人，
于6月29日乘“博天丸”号（s.s. "Hoten Maru"）从大连抵达上海。他入住百老汇大厦酒店（Burlington Hotel），并居住至7月7日，随后前往一个未公开的地址，可能位于法租界。在离开酒店前，他表示大约十天后将返回酒店。据信，M. 加尔金与哈尔滨出版的亲日报纸《哈尔滨时报》（"Harbinskoye Vremia"）有关联。
进一步查询正在进行中。
N. 梅德韦杰夫
特别调查员
副督察（特别处）。
